newsitem.title: USA: Barrett raises capital spending budget.
newsitem.headline: Barrett raises capital spending budget.

text.p: Barrett Resources Corp said on Friday it was increasing its projected capital expenditure budget for 1996 to over $200 million from $131 million.

Barrett said the new expenditures are, in part, a result of successful property acquisitions in the Piceance Basin of Colorado, along with projected spending increases in the Piceance, the Gulf of Mexico, the Wind River Basin of Wyoming, and the Uinta Basin of Utah.

The company said it had acquired about 117 billion cubic feet of proved natural gas reserves in the Piceance Basin, increasing its ownership interest in these gas reserves and existing pipeline system assets to 64 percent from 29.5 percent.
Barrett also said its Gulf of Mexico exploration team in Houston continues to generate additional exploration opportunities, which will lead to additional spending in the Gulf.
